title: Hoplite Team Glow
description: Adds the glowing effect to teammates in Hoplite Competitive Duels.
body: On Hoplite, teammates only have a team glow if they are playing civilization. There's no setting for team glow for teammates in duels, and this fixes this by forcefull applying a glowing effect to teammates in comp. It's 100% allowed as all it does is make it easier to see your teammates, and it was confirmed by a staff member that it's fine. ![Proof thats its allowed (Zuxt is a mod)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98db3b3ea038f4de680868dc2793edbdddaa4531.png)
